name: oois-field-mapper
description: Ozark Occupation Intelligence System - private field mapping app

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "OOIS Field Mapper" com.bobsome1.oois --web-dir=dist
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
